elements.html: GENERAL TERMS & CONDITIONS
EARLY BIRD & LAST MINUTE RATE

GENERAL TERMS & CONDITIONS


All rates we quote are, of course, subject to availability and alteration.


All special offers quoted are limited and subject to availability, and may be subject to a minimum stay.


While every effort has been made to ensure the accuracy of all information, Tandjung Sari Hotel cannot accept liability for any errors or omissions and we reserve the right to change information and descriptions to amend manifest error in the quoted prices.



ONLINE BOOKINGS


Please note that different terms, conditions and cancellation policies in relation to online booking via Tandjung Sari Hotel website may apply, depending on the room or rate and package type chosen.


Please read the room rate details that are provided carefully before you make your online booking. 


Once your booking is made, you will receive an on-screen confirmation reference number – we recommend you make a note of it, though you will also receive an email outlining your reference number and reservation details. In the event that you have to cancel your reservation, you will need your confirmation reference number, as well as the email address used to make the reservation.



GUARANTEED RESERVATIONS


Credit card details are taken at the time of booking for guarantee purposes. By securing your online reservation with a credit card, your room is guaranteed until midnight on the day of arrival, after which the room is released and may be resold. All reservations made on www.tandjungsarihotel.com must be guaranteed with a major credit card (Visa, MasterCard, American Express). In the case of a no show, your credit card will be charged depending on the room or rate and package type chosen. 



EARLY BIRD & LAST MINUTE RATE


When booking an Advance Purchase Rate your credit card will be charged for the entire stay at the time of booking and the cost is completely non-refundable. A cancellation or change will result in forfeit of the cost of the reservation.



CANCELLATIONS


Cancellations must be made within the cancellation period signified on the reservation confirmation. If notice of cancellation is not received by the required date, the hotel will charge one night's accommodation. Please note that some rates (e.g. Early Bird and Last Minute Rates) are non-refundable and in the event of a no show, the full charge of the booking is taken from your credit card.



PROMOTIONS AND OFFERS


All promotional offers are subject to specific terms, conditions and restrictions listed on each promotions and offers. All special offers are subject to availability.



PRICING ERRORS

Tandjung Sari Hotel reserves the right to cancel contracts based upon incorrect information having been displayed in relation to price or service.



LIMITATIONS TO LIABILITY


In no event shall Tandjung Sari Hotel be liable for any direct, special, indirect or consequential damage or damages arising out of your access or use, or your inability to use Tandjung Sari Hotel website, or any materials or recommendations made by third parties on Tandjung Sari Hotel.


You hereby waive any and all claims against us arising out of your use of our website or any materials or recommendations of any third parties on our website. 



WARRANTY DISCLAIMER


The content of Tandjung Sari Hotel website is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, implied or expressed, statutory or otherwise, including without limitation, the warranties of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose. Tandjung Sari Hotel also does not warrant the accuracy or completeness of the information, links or graphics found on Tandjung Sari Hotel website. Tandjung Sari Hotel may make changes to the content or policies at any time without prior notice.



CHILDREN POLICY


Tandjung Sari Hotel is well-known for its tranquil surroundings. Therefore, if you are traveling with children, we respectfully ask for your help to ensure that your children can also enjoy being welcome here by not playing roughly and shouting, especially if they are in the vicinity of public areas such as the restaurant, pool and beach, so that our other guests can also feel comfortable.
